为 iPad 上的排练而设计

把乐谱，放回演奏中央。

读谱、做记号，为下一次排练做好准备。面向各类乐器，以乐团演奏为主要专业场景。

iPadOS 26.0+ · 简体中文 / English

了解当前能力获取支持 ↗

为日常排练准备

从自己的乐谱开始。

从自己的分谱开始：阅读原始页面，调整结构化乐谱的布局，留下下一次排练需要的标记。

01

原谱，清楚地读。

导入 PDF 或未压缩 MusicXML。PDF 保留原稿，支持缩放、平移和手动翻页；MusicXML 可调整音符大小与密度，按阅读视口换行分页。

02

把排练记号留在谱上。

通过 PencilKit 批注，原谱和笔迹保存在本机。扫描可将纸谱保存为图像 PDF；扫描识别成可重排音符尚未提供。

03

从来源明确的曲谱中选择。

在随包的 OpenScore / Mutopia 目录快照中本地搜索，查看声部、许可与署名，再主动下载。当前目录以小提琴 PDF 为主，已下载乐谱可离线阅读。

1.0 版本规划

基础读谱，专注演奏。

基础读谱免费。Pro 计划采用一次性应用内购买，以 US$4.99 为全球定价锚点；各地区以 App Store 上架后的当地货币价格为准。

免费基础版

导入、扫描、读谱、批注、基础乐谱管理、阅读进度与备份。

Pro 专业版

规划支持自动翻谱及双 iPad 双页显示，无订阅。同一 Apple ID 可在第二台 iPad 恢复已购项目，无需重复购买。

Pro 功能仍在准备中，尚未开放购买。自动跟随仅面向受支持的单声部 MusicXML；PDF 与扫描件使用手动翻页。自动跟随及双 iPad 功能尚未经真机验收，最终支持范围将在发布前确认。

需要帮助时

联系视奏器支持。

使用现有 WERD 公开支持邮箱。邮件由你主动发送；本页不会自动上传乐谱或诊断资料。

发送支持邮件 ↗

ericdai2013@gmail.com

请说明 App 版本、iPad 型号、iPadOS 版本、文件格式及复现步骤。分享截图或谱例前，请移除姓名、未公开曲谱和其他不必要内容；不要发送网关令牌或 API 密钥。

哪些文件可以导入？

当前支持 PDF、.xml / .musicxml，单文件须小于 50,000,000 字节；暂不支持压缩 .mxl。加密、无页面或无法解析的文件会拒绝。

相机或麦克风被拒绝后还能读谱吗？

可以继续本地阅读与手动翻页。相机用于主动眼动跟随或扫描，麦克风用于主动演奏跟随；你可以在 iPad 系统设置中管理授权。

备份与删除需要注意什么？

备份文件未加密，请保留原始乐谱并选择可信的保存位置。“最近删除”仍保留原文件，当前没有永久删除控件或自动清理期限。

现在可以下载吗？

SightReader（视奏器）尚未正式上架。此页为产品预览，暂无 App Store 下载入口。

隐私信息

SightReader 的正式隐私政策将在 App Store 发布前提供。此产品预览不是已生效的隐私政策。

如有隐私或支持问题，请联系 ericdai2013@gmail.com。

Product preview · Preparing for the App Store

Made for rehearsal on iPad

Your score. Room to play.

Read, mark your part, and prepare for the next rehearsal. For musicians across instruments, with orchestral performance at the heart of its professional use.

iPadOS 26.0+ · 简体中文 / English

Explore current featuresGet support ↗

Ready for your rehearsal routine

Start with your own part.

Start with your own part: read original pages, adjust structured notation, and keep the marks you need for the next rehearsal.

01

Read the original clearly.

Import PDF or uncompressed MusicXML. PDFs preserve the source page, with zoom, pan and manual turns. MusicXML offers note-size and density controls, with lines and pages fitted to the reading viewport.

02

Keep rehearsal marks on the page.

Annotate with PencilKit, keeping source scores and drawings on this iPad. Scanning saves paper scores as image PDFs; recognition into reflowable notation is not provided.

03

Choose scores with visible sources.

Search the bundled OpenScore / Mutopia catalog snapshot locally, review parts, licenses and attribution, then choose a download. The current catalog focuses on violin PDFs; downloaded scores can be read offline.

The 1.0 plan

Core reading. Professional playing.

Core reading is free. Pro is planned as a one-time in-app purchase anchored at US$4.99 worldwide; local-currency prices will be shown in the App Store at release.

Free core edition

Import, scanning, reading, annotations, basic score management, reading progress and backup.

Pro edition

Planned automatic page turning and a two-page spread across two iPads, with no subscription. Restore the purchase on a second iPad with the same Apple ID without paying again.

Pro is still in preparation and is not available to purchase. Automatic following is limited to supported monophonic MusicXML; PDFs and scans use manual turns. Automatic following and two-iPad features have not completed physical-device acceptance. Final compatibility will be confirmed before release.

When you need a hand

Contact SightReader support.

Use the existing public WERD support address. You choose when to send an email; this page does not automatically upload scores or diagnostics.

Email support ↗

ericdai2013@gmail.com

Include the app version, iPad model, iPadOS version, file format and steps to reproduce. Remove names, unpublished scores and unrelated content before sharing a screenshot or example. Do not send passwords or API keys.

Which files can I import?

The current build accepts PDF and .xml / .musicxml files smaller than 50,000,000 bytes. Compressed .mxl is not supported. Encrypted, empty or unparseable files are rejected.

Can I read after denying camera or microphone access?

Yes. Local reading and manual page turns remain available. The camera supports user-started gaze following or scanning; the microphone supports user-started performance following. Manage access in iPad settings.

What should I know about backups and deletion?

Backup files are unencrypted. Keep your originals and choose a trusted destination. Recently Deleted retains original files; there is currently no permanent-delete control or automatic expiry.

Can I download the app now?

SightReader is not yet released. This is a product preview; an App Store download link is not available yet.

Privacy information

SightReader’s formal privacy policy will be provided before its App Store release. This product preview is not an effective privacy policy.

For privacy or support questions, contact ericdai2013@gmail.com.

原来旅行计划可以如此简单直接

在 App 内选择地点，安排每天的行程。把住宿与预计交通时间放在一起，清楚规划每一步。

产品预览 · App Store 上架准备中

iPhone 与 iPad · 1.0 免费 · 本地新建上限 5 个旅行计划

旅行规划，一起看清

地图看地点，日历看每天。

选好想去的地点，排好每天的行程。住宿与交通参考，也在计划里。地点搜索、路线与交通时间的可用性，会受使用环境、目的地数据、网络和系统服务影响。

01 · 地点规划

从地图开始规划。

在 App 内地图选择地点，加入旅行，再安排到每天的行程。TravelX 1.0 暂不提供导入入口。

02 · 每日安排

把每一站排明白。

在每天的时间轴里调整开始时间、停留时长和顺序。参考相邻地点的预计交通时间，让安排更清楚。

03 · 住宿安排

把住宿也放进计划。

记录入住与退房日期，在当天行程旁查看相关住宿。出发与休息，都有安排。

把旅行规划起来

三步，安排好一段旅行。

  1. 01

    确定日期，选好起点。

    选择出行日期，在 App 内的地图上选一个起点。一天的出游，或一段假期，都可以从这里开始。

  2. 02

    把地点排进每天。

    在 App 内添加想去的地点，安排到当天的行程。什么时候出发、停留多久，都可以继续调整。

  3. 03

    把住宿和交通一起规划。

    记录住宿日期，参考各站之间的预计交通时间。需要具体线路或导航时，可以打开 Apple Maps。

旅行计划，随时调整

计划有变，继续调整。

从今天的安排里移除一站，地点可以留给另一天。旅行默认保存在这台设备上；也可以在设置中开启 iCloud 同步，与同一 iCloud 账号的设备同步。

了解旅行数据如何处理 ↗

关于旅行规划

几个实用的答案。

TravelX 需要付费吗？

TravelX 1.0 免费使用，无需 TravelX 账号，没有内购或订阅。本地新建上限为 5 个旅行计划，旅行、回忆与未设日期的旧草稿合计计数。删除一个可释放名额；已有或同步而来的资料即使超过 5 个，仍完整保留并可编辑，总数降到 5 个以下后可再新建。这是本版的新建限制，不是终身累计创建次数，也没有付费解锁入口。可选 iCloud 同步需要 iCloud 账号。TravelX Pro 尚未推出。

TravelX 支持哪些语言？

TravelX 支持英文、简体中文、繁体中文与香港繁体中文。

只有一天，也能做旅行计划吗？

可以。选择当天的日期和一个起点，就能开始规划。一天出游、周末旅行或一段假期，都可以按天安排。

旅行计划可以继续修改吗？

可以调整旅行日期、地点和每天的活动时间。缩短日期范围时，如果相关日期已有活动或住宿，需要先整理这些安排。

预计交通时间怎样帮助规划？

预计交通时间帮助你安排相邻地点。TravelX 通过 Apple MapKit 获取步行、驾车与公交时间参考；公交的具体线路、换乘与导航可在 Apple Maps 查看。如果采用距离估算，App 会标明来源。

为什么有时搜索、路线或交通时间不可用？

这些服务会受使用环境、目的地数据、网络和系统服务状态影响。某次请求未返回结果，不代表该目的地或交通方式始终不可用。App 会提示服务状态，并标明估算来源。你也可以在 App 内的地图上选择可见地点，继续安排行程。

旅行计划保存在什么地方？

旅行默认保存在这台设备上。在设置中开启可选 iCloud 同步后，可以与同一 iCloud 账号的设备同步；关闭同步会保留本机旅行，不会清除已有云端记录。地图、地点查询与交通时间需要网络，TravelX 不提供完整离线地图。

住宿可以和行程一起安排吗？

可以记录住宿地点、入住与退房日期，并在当天行程旁查看相关住宿。TravelX 用于规划和记录住宿安排。

支持

对旅行规划有疑问？

TravelX 使用与隐私问题可以通过邮件联系。请附上 App 版本、设备与系统版本，以及问题出现前的操作。“设置”中的隐私政策与帮助支持内容可离线阅读。

ericdai2013@gmail.com

只发送解决问题所需的资料。附件中如有私人旅行计划，请先去掉不必要的细节。

旅行数据与你的选择

隐私政策

生效日期：2026-10-13 · 修订日期：2026-10-25

本政策说明 TravelX 的本机旅行存储、可选 iCloud 同步、地图与定位、旧版导入资料、诊断、删除及支持。

政策内容

  1. 1. 旅行数据与可选 iCloud 同步
  2. 2. 地图与可选当前位置
  3. 3. 当前版本、旧版导入资料与本机反馈
  4. 4. 服务、诊断与支持
  5. 5. 存储与保留
  6. 6. 你的选择与删除
  7. 7. 儿童与政策更新
  8. 8. 联系方式

1. 旅行数据与可选 iCloud 同步

TravelX 默认将旅行计划保存在这台设备上。记录包括旅行名称、目的地、日期和已设置的行程时区、地点及坐标、备注与来源链接、每日活动及时间、住宿和交通偏好。既有记录也可能包含你过去保存的同行人数与类型、预算、预计花费或其他字段。

iCloud 同步默认关闭。你在设置中开启后，旅行记录以及同步所需的标识、更改记录和账号隔离信息，会通过 Apple CloudKit 在当前 iCloud 账号的私人数据库中处理，让同一 iCloud 账号的设备同步行程。TravelX 不运营旅行存储服务器，也不把这些记录存入公共 CloudKit 数据库。

TravelX 1.0 免费使用，无需 TravelX 账号，没有内购或订阅。可选 iCloud 同步需要可用的 iCloud 账号与储存空间。TravelX Pro 尚未推出，未来功能和价格将另行公布。

2. 地图与可选当前位置

TravelX 使用 Apple 官方 MapKit 提供地图、地点搜索与查询、路线和预计交通时间。地图区域、搜索文字、所选坐标、路程起终点、交通方式及指定的出发或到达时间，会由地图服务处理；服务也可能处理设备与网络请求信息。

使用“当前位置”时，App 可能请求“使用 App 期间”的定位权限。TravelX 用定位结果在前台地图显示或聚焦你的位置，不会把当前设备位置保存进旅行记录或同步至 CloudKit。定位是可选的，可以在系统设置中更改。你保存的目的地、地点坐标和行程时区选择属于另一类旅行数据。行程时区来自目的地或地点资料，也可以由你选择，不是对当前设备位置的持久记录。

打开 Apple Maps 查看具体线路或导航时，适用该 App 自身的权限、设置与隐私规则。服务可用性受目的地、网络、系统服务和使用环境影响；TravelX 不提供完整离线地图。

Apple 说明，在中国的 Apple 地图产品使用高德软件有限公司的地图服务。相关服务处理方式见所附 Apple 地图隐私说明。

3. 当前版本、旧版导入资料与本机反馈

TravelX 1.0 不提供导入入口，也不包含 Apple Maps 分享扩展。请在 App 内地图添加地点。本版本不会通过导入流程接收新的 Apple Maps 分享地点或指南链接。

此前构建版本的记录可能包含来源链接，以及本机 App Group 导入收件箱中的地点名称、坐标、已提供的时区资料、地址和导入状态。关闭入口不会自动移除已有收件箱内容。此前已保存到旅行的地点仍属于旅行记录；开启 iCloud 同步后，这些记录也可能同步。

此前构建版本可通过系统网络服务请求指南网页，涉及链接、通常的网络信息、重定向、cookie 或缓存。关闭导入入口不会清除此前的记录或系统缓存。TravelX 1.0 不提供这条指南导入请求流程。

添加地点后的短暂实时活动，可能按系统设置在灵动岛或锁定屏幕显示地点名称及完成提示。TravelX 在本机提供这项反馈，没有远程实时活动更新服务。

4. 服务、诊断与支持

Apple 按其自身规则提供 CloudKit、地图及其他系统服务。TravelX 不使用旅行数据进行广告跟踪，也不出售这些数据。App 没有开发者自建的分析或崩溃上传服务。系统诊断可能包含错误代码、导入数量、链接主机与路径、查询参数名称或其他诊断细节；Apple 的分析设置可能影响诊断共享。

你主动发送支持邮件时，开发者会收到邮箱地址、邮件内容和你选择发送的附件，用于回复请求和排查问题。打开支持邮件入口不会自动发送邮件、旅行记录或日志。请只发送所需资料，并遮去截图中的私人行程。

你访问产品网站时，托管服务提供方会处理网页请求，并可能按其自身规则处理请求元数据或 cookie。网站在本地保存你选择的语言与外观偏好，不通过该网页上传 App 旅行记录。信息还可能因法律要求、保护权利与安全或你的请求而披露。

5. 存储与保留

本地旅行文件、旧版导入收件箱内容、同步记录及临时文件保存在这台设备上，受 App 沙盒与设备保护。本版本不会通过导入入口向收件箱添加新内容。可选 CloudKit 记录使用你的 iCloud 储存空间及 Apple 的服务保护。

TravelX 可能保留迁移备份、协调删除所需的记录，以及冲突或恢复副本。关闭同步会停止 App 的同步会话并保留本机记录，不会清除已经存在 iCloud 中的旅行。Apple 设备备份与实时行程同步不同，可能按你的设置包含 App 数据。

支持邮件用于答复请求和处理相关问题。任何数字系统或删除流程都不能保证立即擦除每一份历史副本。

6. 你的选择与删除

你可以在 App 内编辑和删除旅行。仅移除某天的安排，可以保留已保存地点供其他日期使用。同步开启且正常工作时，行程更改与删除会排队同步至同一 iCloud 账号；离线或同步失败可能延迟其他设备上的更新。同步后旅行日期发生重叠时，会保留内容供你查看和处理，不会自动替你删除旅行。

删除可见旅行，不保证清除旧版导入收件箱内容、迁移备份、同步恢复记录、冲突副本、设备备份或此前已分享的副本。关闭同步不是清除云端数据的操作。你可以通过 Apple 的设置管理 App 储存空间、iCloud 储存空间、设备备份与定位权限；如需了解仍保留的副本，可以联系支持。

7. 儿童与政策更新

TravelX 是通用旅行规划工具，没有儿童专用账号或画像系统。

功能或数据处理方式改变时，本政策会修订。App 内政策可在“设置 → 隐私政策”离线阅读；公开网站副本另行更新。

8. 联系方式

TravelX 使用与隐私问题，请联系 ericdai2013@gmail.com。

A map for the places. A calendar for the days.

Choose the places. Arrange the days. Keep stays and travel references beside the plan. Place search, routes, and travel-time availability depend on your current environment, destination data, network conditions, and system services.

01 · Places

Plan from the map.

02 · Daily plans

Give each stop its time.

Adjust start times, visit lengths, and activity order in the daily timeline. Review estimated travel times between stops to keep the plan clear.

03 · Stays

Bring stays into the plan.

Record check-in and check-out dates and see the relevant stay beside each day. Know where the day starts and where you will rest.

MAKE YOUR TRIP A PLAN

Three steps to a clear trip plan.

  1. 01

    Choose dates and a starting place.

    Pick your dates and a place on the in-app map. A day out or a longer holiday can start here.

  2. 02

    Arrange places by day.

    Add places inside the app and arrange them in the day’s plan. Start times and visit lengths can change as your plans take shape.

ABOUT TRIP PLANNING

A few useful answers.

Is TravelX free?

TravelX 1.0 is free, with no TravelX account, in-app purchase, or subscription. You can create a new trip locally while fewer than five trips are saved, counting Trips, Memories, and older undated drafts together. Delete a trip to free a slot. Existing or synced records remain complete and editable even if the total exceeds five; local creation resumes below five. This is a current-version creation limit, not a lifetime count or paid unlock. Optional iCloud sync needs an iCloud account. TravelX Pro has not launched.

Which languages does TravelX support?

TravelX supports English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Hong Kong Chinese.

Can I plan a one-day trip?

Yes. Choose that day’s date and a starting place to begin. A day out, a weekend, or a longer holiday can be arranged day by day.

Can I keep editing my trip plan?

You can adjust trip dates, places, and daily activity times. Before shortening a date range that already has activities or stays, organize those plans first.

How do travel-time estimates help planning?

Estimated travel times help you arrange your stops. TravelX uses Apple MapKit for walking, driving, and public-transport time references. Open Apple Maps for detailed public-transport routes, transfers, and navigation. If a distance-based estimate is used, the app labels its source.

Why are search, routes, or travel times sometimes unavailable?

Availability depends on your current environment, destination data, network conditions, and system services. A request without a result does not mean the destination or transport mode is always unavailable. The app shows service status and identifies the estimate source. You can also select visible places on the in-app map and keep arranging your days.

Where is my trip plan saved?

Trips are stored on this device by default. Enable optional iCloud sync in Settings to sync trips across devices using the same iCloud account. Turning it off keeps local trips and does not erase existing cloud records. Maps, place lookup, and travel-time estimates need network services; TravelX does not provide complete offline maps.

Can I plan stays alongside the itinerary?

Record accommodation places and check-in/check-out dates, then see the relevant stay beside the day. TravelX helps plan and record accommodation arrangements.

1. Trip data and optional iCloud sync

TravelX stores trip plans on your device by default. Records include trip names, destinations, dates and any saved trip time zone, places and coordinates, notes and source links, daily activities and times, stays, and travel preferences. Existing records may also contain companion counts and types, budgets, estimated costs, or other fields you previously saved.

iCloud sync is off by default. If you enable it in Settings, trip records and the identifiers, change records, and account-scoping information needed for sync are processed through Apple CloudKit using your iCloud account’s private database. This lets devices using the same iCloud account sync trips. TravelX does not operate a trip-storage server or use a public CloudKit database for these records.

TravelX 1.0 is free to use, with no TravelX account, in-app purchase, or subscription. Optional iCloud sync requires an available iCloud account and storage. TravelX Pro has not launched; any future features and pricing will be announced separately.

2. Maps and optional current location

TravelX uses Apple’s official MapKit for maps, place search and lookup, routes, and estimated travel times. Map areas, search text, selected coordinates, journey endpoints, transport modes, and requested departure or arrival times are handled by map services, which may also process device and network request information.

Using Current Location can ask for location access while you use the app. TravelX uses the result to show or focus your position on the foreground map; it does not save your current device location in trip records or sync it to CloudKit. Location access is optional, and you can change it in system Settings. Saved destinations, place coordinates, and trip time-zone choices are separate trip data. A trip time zone comes from destination/place information or your selection, not a saved record of your current device location.

Opening Apple Maps for detailed directions or navigation uses that app’s own permissions, settings, and privacy practices. Service availability depends on the destination, network, system services, and your environment; TravelX does not provide complete offline maps.

Apple states that its Maps product in China uses mapping services from Amap Software Co., Ltd. The linked Apple Maps privacy information explains those service practices.

3. Current release, legacy import data, and on-device feedback

TravelX 1.0 does not provide an import entry or include the Apple Maps sharing extension. Add places on the in-app map. This version does not receive new shared Apple Maps places or Guide links through an import flow.

Records from earlier builds may include source links and an on-device App Group import inbox containing place names, coordinates, provided time-zone information, addresses, and import state. Closing the entry does not automatically remove existing inbox content. Places already saved to a trip remain trip records and may sync if iCloud sync is enabled.

Earlier builds could request Guide webpages using the system networking service, involving the link, normal network information, redirects, cookies, or caches. Closing the import entry does not clear previous records or system caches. TravelX 1.0 does not provide this Guide-import request flow.

A brief Live Activity for a place you add may show its name and completion message on the Dynamic Island or Lock Screen, subject to system settings. TravelX supplies this feedback locally, without a remote Live Activity update service.

4. Services, diagnostics, and support

Apple provides CloudKit, map, and other system services under its own practices. TravelX does not use trip data for advertising tracking or sell it. The app has no developer-operated analytics or crash-upload service. System diagnostics may contain error codes, import counts, link hosts and paths, query-key names, or other diagnostic details; Apple’s analytics settings may affect diagnostic sharing.

When you choose to email support, the developer receives your email address, message, and any attachments you send to answer the request and investigate issues. Opening the support email action does not automatically send a message, trip records, or logs. Send only what is needed, and remove private trip details from screenshots.

When you visit the product website, its hosting provider processes page requests and may handle request metadata or cookies under its own practices. The site stores your chosen language and appearance preferences locally. App trip records are not uploaded through that page. Information may also be disclosed when legally required, to protect rights and safety, or at your request.

5. Storage and retention

Local trip files, legacy import inbox content, sync records, and temporary files are kept on this device under app-sandbox and device protections. This release does not add new inbox content through an import entry. Optional CloudKit records use your iCloud account’s storage and Apple’s service protections.

TravelX may keep migration backups, records needed to reconcile deletions, and conflict or recovery copies. Turning off sync stops the app’s sync session and keeps local records; it does not erase trips already in iCloud. Apple device backups are separate from live trip sync and may include app data according to your settings.

Support correspondence is handled to respond to your request and resolve related issues. No digital system or deletion process can guarantee that every historical copy is immediately erased.

6. Your choices and deletion

You can edit and delete trips in the app. Removing a daily assignment can leave the saved place available for another day. With sync enabled and working, trip changes and deletions are queued for the same iCloud account; offline or failed sync may delay changes on other devices. If synced trips have overlapping dates, their content is kept for you to review and resolve rather than automatically deleting a trip.

Deleting visible trips does not guarantee removal of legacy import inbox content, migration backups, sync recovery records, conflict copies, device backups, or previously shared copies. Turning sync off is not a cloud-data erasure action. Use Apple’s settings to manage app storage, iCloud storage, device backups, and location permissions; contact support to ask about retained copies.

7. Children and policy updates

TravelX is a general trip-planning tool with no child-specific account or profiling system.

This policy is revised when features or data practices change. The bundled policy is available in Settings → Privacy Policy even offline; a public website copy is updated separately.
